rank_rule: Problems with a world figure in two years at least five years apart are ranked by pace: the yearly rate at which the thing that should fall is changing over about ten years (for a coverage that should rise, the share still left out). Growing problems rank first, then stalled ones, then the slowest improvers. Pace compares directions across different units; it does not measure how many people are harmed. Where the wording does not make clear whether a rise is good or bad, the entry is described as changing and is not ranked; a figure that starts from zero is described as new, never as growth. Problems with no usable world figure are listed unranked.
